issues_encountered: RUN_2026-04-24_20-52-14: 374 DRT-0074 'No access point for PIN' errors at step 40 (DetailedRouting) — all 373 top-level I/O pins affected

Root cause: FP_IO_HLENGTH/FP_IO_VLENGTH not set; OpenROAD place_pins uses minimum-area pin (~0.083um) which is shorter than one RIGHTWAYONGRIDONLY grid pitch on ASAP7 M4/M5 (0.048um pitch); DRT cannot form any on-grid via access point on the sub-pitch pin stub

Misdiagnosis in task description: suggested FP_IO_LAYERS which does not exist in LibreLane; ASAP7 PDK already defaults FP_IO_HLAYER=M4, FP_IO_VLAYER=M5 via /home/neuromorphic/pdk/asap7/libs.tech/openlane/config.tcl

issues_encountered: RUN_2026-04-25_07-28-05 (run 3): DRT-0074 persisted even after FP_IO_HLENGTH=4.0/FP_IO_VLENGTH=4.0 fix from run 2

True root cause: FP_IO_HTHICKNESS_MULT/VTHICKNESS_MULT left at default=2, yielding pin width 2*24=48 DBU. M4/M5 WIDTHTABLE requires 24, 120, 216... DBU; 48 DBU is NOT a valid width. Additionally, width=pitch=48 DBU means ~50% probability of zero on-grid tracks inside the pin rect depending on track grid offset at pin position. DRT 'Start pin access' phase aborts before detailed_route even runs — drt.tcl catch block does NOT help for this failure mode.
fixes_applied: Added FP_IO_HTHICKNESS_MULT: 5 to pnr/asap7/config.json — pin width = 5*24 = 120 DBU = 0.12um (valid M4 WIDTHTABLE entry, 2.5 pitches, guaranteed 2+ on-grid tracks)
Added FP_IO_VTHICKNESS_MULT: 5 to pnr/asap7/config.json — same for M5 vertical pins
